stories.headline: SK Hynix Posts Record Q1 With 72% Operating Margin as HBM Demand Exceeds Supply for 3 Years

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix reported Q1 revenue of 52.58 trillion won ($38.9B), up 198% YoY, the first time quarterly revenue surpassed 50 trillion won.
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue also hit a record 52.58 trillion won ($38.9 billion), up 198 percent from the same period a year earlier. It is the first time SK hynix's quarterly revenue has surpassed 50 trillion won.

key_facts.fact: Operating profit reached a record 37.61 trillion won ($27.8B), up 405% YoY, with an operating margin of 72%, surpassing both Samsung Electronics (43%) and major Big Tech companies.
key_facts.excerpt: The operating margin reached 72 percent on surging demand for HBM, a high-margin product.

key_facts.fact: Net profit reached 40.35 trillion won ($29.8B), including approximately 14 trillion won in non-operating income from foreign exchange gains and valuation gains.
key_facts.excerpt: Net profit reached 40.346 trillion won ($29.8 billion), reflecting approximately 14 trillion won ($10.3 billion) in non-operating income from foreign exchange gains and valuation gains on investment assets.

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix said HBM demand will exceed its production capacity for the next three years and announced plans to ship HBM4E samples in H2 2026, with mass production in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: "HBM demand required over the next three years exceeds our production capacity," SK hynix said.

key_facts.fact: DRAM ASP rose mid-60% range QoQ, NAND ASP rose mid-70% range QoQ; average HBM DRAM price jumped to $13, ten times the $1.35 of a year earlier.
key_facts.excerpt: According to market research firm DRAMeXchange, the average price of DRAM used in HBM jumped to $13 at the end of the first quarter this year, ten times the $1.35 of a year earlier.

key_facts.fact: Cash and equivalents reached 54.3 trillion won, up 19.4 trillion won QoQ, with net cash of 35 trillion won after borrowings fell to 19.3 trillion won.
key_facts.excerpt: First-quarter cash and cash equivalents rose 19.4 trillion won from the previous quarter to 54.3 trillion won. Borrowings decreased 2.9 trillion won, leaving net cash of 35 trillion won.

stories.headline: TSMC Unveils Roadmap Through 2029 With A12 and A13 Nodes, Skips ASML's High-NA EUV Through Decade

key_facts.fact: TSMC revealed A13 (1.3nm) and A12 (1.2nm) process nodes at its 2026 North American Technology Symposium, both targeted for production in 2029. A13 offers 6% area savings over A14 with full backward compatibility.
key_facts.excerpt: The A13 process is a direct shrink of TSMC's A14 node announced in 2025, which provides 6% area savings from A14. The A13 design rules are fully backward compatible with A14.

key_facts.fact: TSMC will not use ASML's high-NA EUV machines (costing €350M+ each) for any production nodes through 2029, choosing to maximize current EUV equipment instead.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC has no plans to buy ASML's most advanced litho tool – the $350 million high-NA EUV machine... 'We continue to be able to harvest the benefit from current EUV,' said Zhang.

key_facts.fact: TSMC is adopting a dual-track strategy: new client/mobile nodes every year, and AI/HPC nodes with backside power delivery every two years. A16 slipped to 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC is adopting a new strategy for process technology introductions, offering a new node for client applications every year and for heavy-duty AI and HPC applications every two years.

key_facts.fact: A 14-reticle size CoWoS package capable of integrating 10 large compute dies and 20 HBM stacks is slated for production in 2028, with beyond-14-reticle and 40-reticle SoW-X in 2029.
key_facts.excerpt: A 14-reticle size CoWoS, capable of integrating approximately 10 large compute dies and 20 HBM stacks, is slated for production in 2028.

key_facts.fact: TSMC SVP Kevin Zhang confirmed the company plans to open a CoWoS and 3D-IC advanced chip packaging plant in Arizona by 2029, with construction already underway.
key_facts.excerpt: "We are going to build a CoWoS capability and 3D-IC capability there before 2029, so that's still our goal," Zhang said.

key_facts.fact: The decision contrasts with Intel, which has installed ASML's High-NA EUV system and expects risk production in 2027, and Samsung, which received its first High-NA scanner in late 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel has already installed ASML's Twinscan EXE:5200B High-NA system and expects risk production in 2027 with volume output in 2028. Samsung received its first High-NA scanner in late 2025.

stories.headline: Tesla Becomes Intel's First Major 14A Customer for Terafab AI Chip Manufacturing Complex

key_facts.fact: Elon Musk said during Tesla's Q1 earnings call that Tesla plans to use Intel's 14A process for chips at the Terafab AI complex in Austin, making Tesla the first major external customer for the node.
key_facts.excerpt: The decision, disclosed by Musk on Wednesday, would make Tesla the first major external customer for Intel's most advanced manufacturing node.

key_facts.fact: Musk said '14A seems like the right move' and that by the time Terafab scales up, the technology should be 'fairly mature or ready for prime time.'
key_facts.excerpt: "14A seems like the right move, and we have a great relationship with Intel," Musk said, adding that by the time Tesla's project scales, the technology should be "fairly mature or ready for prime time."

key_facts.fact: Terafab is designed to deliver up to one terawatt of AI compute annually, roughly double the current total generated across the US, with construction alone estimated at $25 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Once fully ramped, the sprawling fabrication complex is expected to deliver up to one terawatt of AI compute annually... The overall chipmaking buildout is also estimated to cost about $25 billion in construction alone.

key_facts.fact: Intel's 14A process is expected to reach production readiness in 2027, with early PDK versions already rolling out to external customers this year.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel's 14A process is expected to reach production readiness in 2027, with early versions of its process design kit (PDK) already rolling out to external customers beginning this year.

key_facts.fact: Tesla CFO said the company expects over $25 billion in capex this year. SpaceX will be responsible for high-volume chip manufacturing at TeraFab.
key_facts.excerpt: Elon Musk says his TeraFab facilities will use Intel's 14A process technology to make AI chips — SpaceX will be responsible for high-volume chip manufacturing in likely Intel tech licensing deal

stories.headline: Texas Instruments Q1 Revenue Jumps 19% to $4.83B as Data Center Nearly Doubles, Guides Q2 Above Street

key_facts.fact: TI reported Q1 revenue of $4.83B, up 19% YoY, beating analyst estimates of $4.53B by 6.6%. EPS of $1.68 beat estimates of $1.36 by 23.1%.
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue increased 9% sequentially and 19% from the same quarter a year ago with growth led by industrial and data center.

key_facts.fact: Data Center revenue nearly doubled YoY (~90% growth), while Industrial revenue rose over 30% YoY with broad-based gains across sectors and regions.
key_facts.excerpt: CEO Haviv Ilan emphasized that Industrial revenue rose over 30% year over year... while Data Center growth approached 90%.

key_facts.fact: Q2 revenue guidance of $5.0B-$5.4B ($5.2B midpoint) was 7.1% above analyst estimates of $4.86B. Q2 EPS guidance of $1.77-$2.05 also beat consensus.
key_facts.excerpt: TI's second quarter outlook is for revenue in the range of $5.00 billion to $5.40 billion and earnings per share between $1.77 and $2.05.

key_facts.fact: Operating margin expanded to 37.5% from 32.5% a year earlier. Trailing 12-month free cash flow surged 154% YoY to $4.35B.
key_facts.excerpt: Operating Margin: 37.5%, up from 32.5% in the same quarter last year... Free Cash Flow was $1.40 billion, up from -$274 million in the same quarter last year

key_facts.fact: CEO Ilan called it 'the first quarter where we saw the broad market starting to wake up again after a long hibernation,' marking 8 consecutive quarters of sequential growth.
key_facts.excerpt: Ilan described it as the "first quarter where we saw the broad market...starting to wake up again after a long hibernation."

stories.headline: 37,000 Samsung Workers Rally at Pyeongtaek Chip Campus, Threaten 18-Day Strike Over Bonus Demands

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics' labor union rallied up to 37,000-40,000 workers at the Pyeongtaek semiconductor campus on April 23, the union's largest show of force to date.
key_facts.excerpt: Thousands of Samsung Electronics workers rallied Thursday at its computer chip complex in Pyeongtaek... Union officials said about 40,000 members participated in the protest.

key_facts.fact: The union demands 15% of annual operating profit as performance bonuses with no cap. With Samsung's projected full-year operating profit at ~306 trillion won, that implies a ~45 trillion won payout.
key_facts.excerpt: The union is demanding 15 percent of annual operating profit as performance bonuses without a cap.

key_facts.fact: The union has threatened an 18-day walkout from May 21 through June 7 if negotiations fail, which it claims would cost Samsung more than 1 trillion won ($676M) per day.
key_facts.excerpt: The union has threatened to stage an 18-day walkout starting May 21 if negotiations with management fail and claims that such action would cost the company more than 1 trillion won ($676 million) a day.

key_facts.fact: A small group of retail shareholders staged a counterdemonstration, with one organizer calling the union's demands 'no different from a predatory creditor's,' citing that the 45T won demand dwarfs the 11.1T won Samsung paid in dividends last year.
key_facts.excerpt: Min Gyeong-kwon, who organized the protest, compared the union's demands to those of a predatory creditor.

key_facts.fact: Union membership has tripled since Samsung's first worker walkout in 2024 to over 90,000 members, representing more than 70% of South Korean staff. Workers cite a pay gap with rival SK Hynix.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung's union, which represents about 74,000 workers, says the company has failed to offer adequate compensation despite its strong performance.

key_facts.fact: Samsung filed for a court injunction to block occupation of production lines. The rally came hours after SK Hynix posted record earnings, sharpening comparisons.
key_facts.excerpt: The company has filed for a court injunction to block occupation of production lines.

stories.headline: Microsoft Commits AU$25B ($18B) to Australian AI Infrastructure by 2029, Its Largest Investment There

key_facts.fact: Microsoft will invest AU$25 billion (US$18 billion) in capital and operational expenditure in Australia by end of 2029, its largest-ever investment in the country.
key_facts.excerpt: By the end of 2029, the company will invest A$25 billion (USD 18 billion) in new digital infrastructure.

key_facts.fact: The investment will expand Microsoft's Azure AI supercomputing and cloud infrastructure, increasing its Australian footprint by more than 140% by end of 2029.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft will see increased growth across Commercial Cloud and AI/GPU offerings... with plans underway to expand our existing footprint by more than 140 percent by the end of 2029.

key_facts.fact: Announced by Satya Nadella alongside PM Anthony Albanese during Microsoft's AI Tour in Sydney, the deal includes training 3 million Australians in AI skills by 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft on Thursday announced a A$25 billion ($18 billion) investment into Australia's digital infrastructure... training three million Australians on the use of AI by 2028.

key_facts.fact: The deal builds on a prior AU$5B commitment from October 2023. Microsoft currently operates 29 datacenter sites across three Azure regions in Australia.
key_facts.excerpt: The company currently operates 29 datacentre sites across three Azure regions in Australia, following an earlier A$5 billion investment announced in October 2023.

key_facts.fact: Australia has also received AI infrastructure pledges from AWS (AU$20B) and OpenAI (AU$7B), as Canberra positions itself as a key Asia-Pacific AI hub.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon Web Services pledged a A$20 billion investment in Australia, and in December, Australia announced a A$7 billion investment from OpenAI.

stories.headline: Lutnick Says No Nvidia H200 Chips Sold to China Yet, Beijing Hasn't Approved Purchases

key_facts.fact: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick told the Senate Appropriations Committee that Nvidia's H200 chips have not yet been sold to Chinese companies.
key_facts.excerpt: Howard Lutnick, the US Secretary of Commerce, stated that the advanced artificial intelligence (AI) chip, the H200, has not yet been sold to Chinese companies.

key_facts.fact: Lutnick said the Chinese government has not approved the purchases, citing Beijing's focus on investing in its domestic semiconductor industry.
key_facts.excerpt: Le gouvernement central chinois ne les a pas encore autorisés à acheter les puces, parce qu'il essaie de concentrer son investissement sur sa propre industrie nationale.

key_facts.fact: The Trump administration approved H200 exports to China after the US-China summit in October, but deliveries have been stalled by disagreements on conditions on both sides.
key_facts.excerpt: En janvier, l'administration Trump a donné son feu vert officiel aux ventes de puces H200... Mais les livraisons de puces ont été entravées par des désaccords sur les conditions de vente.

key_facts.fact: Lutnick emphasized 'The United States will not sell its best semiconductors to China under any circumstances,' noting Blackwell chips are not being sold at all.
key_facts.excerpt: Lutnik emphasised... 'the United States will not sell its best semiconductors to China under any circumstances'. The H200 chip is based on the Hopper architecture and its performance is about six times higher than the H20 chip.

key_facts.fact: Lutnick also appeared to back away from reimposing the 'affiliates rule' restricting tech exports to thousands of Chinese companies, saying it's part of the broader trade deal balance.
key_facts.excerpt: "Je suis d'accord pour dire que la règle des affiliés est une chose intelligente que les États-Unis d'Amérique devraient envisager, mais elle fait partie de l'équilibre de cet accord commercial complet."

sources.title: US Commerce Secretary: 'China Has Not Purchased a Single Nvidia H200 Chip'
